scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The Deligne-Drinfeld conjecture” (preprints/The-Deligne-Drinfeld-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 008 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5ae63f326803a634), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are homogeneous elements σ2k+1 ∈ W2k+1, one for each k ≥ 1, for which LieQ⟨e3, e5, e7, . . .⟩ −→ (W, { , }), e2k+1 7−→ σ2k+1, is an isomorphism of graded Lie algebras.
